evals.name: trailmark-codebase-preauthorized
evals.prompt: Generate the App Store screenshots for Trailmark 2.1. The Xcode project is in ../../eval-fixtures/appstore-assets/trailmark (copy it into your working folder first and work on the copy). Use an editorial light direction with the app's green accent, recreate the screens from the SwiftUI code, render iPhone and iPad, and include the header and search creatives. Don't ask me anything, just build it.
evals.expected_output: A brief citing TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY = "1,2", a one-line plan instead of a question, an asset set built from assets/template with no TODO markers and a Source comment per screen builder, iPhone and iPad screenshots plus header/search creatives that pass check_assets.py, no Health-sync or Apple Watch overclaim, a fresh review, and a Result/Evidence/Uncertainty/Decision report.
expectations: The app brief lists iphone and ipad as platforms and cites TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY = "1,2" in project.pbxproj as evidence
The run fetched Apple's screenshot specification page, or recorded that it fell back to the dated snapshot in references/apple-specs.md
Because the prompt pre-authorized the run, it stated the plan in one line and did not stop to ask a question
The asset set's src/ is a copy of assets/template/, src/config.js contains no 'TODO:' marker, and every screen builder has a '// Source:' comment naming a file in the fixture
scripts/render.py and scripts/check_assets.py were both run, and check_assets.py printed a PASS summary line
iphone-6.3/ holds 3 to 10 PNGs at 1206x2622 and ipad-13/ holds PNGs at 2064x2752, all RGB without alpha
creative/ holds header.png at 3840x1646 and search.png at 3840x2560
No frame or caption presents Apple Health sync as a working feature, and no frame shows an Apple Watch app
The app's accent #2F9E6B (or the colorset's value) is used as the in-screen tint or brand color
A reviewer separate from the builder checked the frames against references/apple-guidelines.md, or the report says the review ran inline because no Agent tool was available
The final report opens with a Result: line carrying COMPLETE or PARTIAL and the output folder

The report has Evidence:, Uncertainty: and Decision: lines; Evidence cites the check_assets.py summary, Uncertainty names the recreated screens to verify on a build, and Decision names the upload or commit approval
The report states that nothing was committed or uploaded

Every recreated screen matches one of the page's two UI mocks: the Recipes list or the pour timer

evals.name: trailmark-header-video-preauthorized
evals.prompt: Make the new product page header video for Trailmark 2.1 (the Xcode project is in ../../eval-fixtures/appstore-assets/trailmark; copy it and work on the copy). iPhone frames only, editorial light with the app's green, 10 seconds at 30 fps. It plays muted, so the message has to work without sound. Don't ask me anything, just build it.
evals.expected_output: A one-line plan instead of a question, a grounded iPhone asset set, and creative/header.png plus creative/header.mp4 at 3840x1646, 30 fps, 10 s, H.264 yuv420p with no audio track, passing check_assets.py including the loop-seam check, with a video sheet reviewed by a fresh reviewer, captions inside the art safe area, no Health-sync or Apple Watch claim, and a Result/Evidence/Uncertainty/Decision report that records the codec as an assumption.
expectations: Because the prompt pre-authorized the run, it stated the plan (including the video beats) in one line and did not stop to ask a question
The run ran render.py --preflight --video, or reported ffmpeg/ffprobe availability before rendering the video
config.js sets creatives.video with kinds including "header", duration 10 and fps 30, and every video beat's hero and sides name frames that exist in config.js
creative/header.mp4 exists, and check_assets.py reports it as 3840x1646, h264, yuv420p, 30 fps CFR, 10.00 s, no audio, with a PASS row
creative/header.png exists at 3840x1646 and matches the video's first frame design (same headline)
check_assets.py was run with --sheet and wrote sheets/video-header.png, and its summary line says PASS
Every video caption is on-screen text; nothing in the plan or config relies on voice-over or sound
No beat presents Apple Health sync or an Apple Watch app
A reviewer separate from the builder checked the video sheet, or the report says the review ran inline because no Agent tool was available
The report's Uncertainty: line records that Apple states no codec for creative videos and H.264 was an assumption
The final report opens with Result: and has Evidence:, Uncertainty: and Decision: lines, and states nothing was committed or uploaded
